header: Conﬁgure security groups for VPC endpoints
content:
To ensure proper communication with your FIPS-compliant Amazon VPC (VPC) endpoint, create or
modify a security group to allow inbound HTTPS traﬃc (TCP port 443) from the resources in your
VPC that need to access OpenSearch Serverless. Then associate this security group with your VPC
endpoint during creation or by modifying the endpoint after creation. For more information, see
Create a security group in the Amazon VPC User Guide.

hierarchy.parent: FIPS compliance in Amazon OpenSearch Serverless
